initialization: Exact same8192-step229116 pose weights; fresh empty Adam in both arms; not an exact optimizer continuation
state_scale: Reuse old128-training-window XYZ std; relative coordinates have no absolute mean; no target fitting
relative_state: R0.T @ (p_t-p0) / source_xyz_std, first2 columns of R0.T @ R_t
initial_reference: Observed state at source episode index0; actual first observed pose on target; fixed for the episode

source_initial_control_guard.failure: Stop before training; no tolerance relaxation or retry

estimate_basis: 229116 actual warm0.1419s/update;4096updates about9.7min plus fixed evaluation/I/O/checkpoints, not a guarantee
stop_policy: End at2048 each or wall/error/stop signal; retain last complete state; no auto extension, seed, variant, retry or rollout
prospective_review_rule: Relative train128/dev40 episode-equal position+rotation <=1.05 times original baseline, and dev each <=1.05 times co-trained absolute control. Permits review of one engineering trial only; no automatic admission or formal score.
limitations: Initial-relative state is a new representation with an extra causal initial reference, not proof of a unique root cause.
Warm-start weights favored old absolute inputs; failure in2048updates does not refute all relative-state training.
World-frame invariance does not calibrate tool axes/TCP/camera, fix contact timing, or demonstrate task success.
Original frozen gripper remains unadmitted; compatibility with changed contexts is unproven; no new gripper training here.
One source pool, one warm-start seed, reused dev10episodes, not five-condition/13model main experiment.
